thread:
Ravi Kapoor: quick note from today's spike: proposing a "local reconciler" pattern. problem: multiple observers emit noisy signals and routers get conflicting fallback commands. idea: local reconciler ingests envelopes, applies tenant policy, emits one canonical decision event per-epoch. keeps local fast path, chips in to global only on cross-region escalation.
Nina Flores: sounds good. question: how to avoid a single-point-of-failure? suggest lease-based leader per-region and short TTL on decisions so routers can revert if reconciler fails.
Jon Park: agree on leases. also require decisions be idempotent: include decision_id + seq. router applies only if seq > last_seq. reconciler should emit intended_effect and an expires_at.
Ravi Kapoor: policy DSL sketch (informal): metric, threshold, action (soft_degrade/full_fallback), steps, consecutive_windows, cooldown_secs. Example: "p95_latency > 1200 -> soft_degrade steps [80,50] consecutive 2 cooldown 600".
Nina Flores: add signal fusion rule: require two orthogonal signals (latency+err_rate) before major escalations. also smoothing: exponential smoothing alpha=0.25 and min_windows=2.
Jon Park: runtime: reconciler -> emits event {decision_id, tenant, intent, contributing_signals, ttl, issued_by, seq}. enforcement: router respects TTL, sequence, and manual overrides (higher priority).
reconcile-bot: notice: staging reconciler emitted decision tenant="acme" region="us-west-2" reason="p95>1200 & err_rate>1%" action="propose_soft_degrade(50%)" decision_id=dec-2085-01
Ravi Kapoor: ops asks for observability: include contributing_signals, weights, and a short counterfactual note (what would have happened if not hedged). emit metrics: decisions_per_min, avg_signal_to_decision_ms, hedge_success_rate.
Nina Flores: tests: simulate observer outage, clock skew, and partial partition. ensure routers revert when decision TTL expires. also add chaos test where reconciler is partitioned and global reconciler doesn't auto-override local decisions without quorum.
Jon Park: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with API surface: POST /signals, POST /decisions (reconciler -> events), GET /decisions?tenant=..., SSE /decisions/stream. include schema_v. Ravi please review and add escalation matrix.
Ravi Kapoor: will do. thanks all.
